3565
3566static bool ocl_mulSpectrums( InputArray _srcA, InputArray _srcB,
3567 OutputArray _dst, int flags, bool conjB )
3568{
3569 int atype = _srcA.type(), btype = _srcB.type(),
3570 rowsPerWI = ocl::Device::getDefault().isIntel() ? 4 : 1;
3571 Size asize = _srcA.size(), bsize = _srcB.size();
3572 CV_Assert(asize == bsize);
3573
3574 if ( !(atype == CV_32FC2 && btype == CV_32FC2) || flags != 0 )
3575 return false;
3576
3577 UMat A = _srcA.getUMat(), B = _srcB.getUMat();
3578 CV_Assert(A.size() == B.size());
3579
3580 _dst.createSameSize(A, atype);
3581 UMat dst = _dst.getUMat();
3582
3583 ocl::Kernel k("mulAndScaleSpectrums",
3584 ocl::core::mulspectrums_oclsrc,
3585 format("%s", conjB ? "-D CONJ" : ""));
3586 if (k.empty())
3587 return false;
3588
3589 k.args(ocl::KernelArg::ReadOnlyNoSize(A), ocl::KernelArg::ReadOnlyNoSize(B),
3590 ocl::KernelArg::WriteOnly(dst), rowsPerWI);
3591
3592 size_t globalsize[2] = { (size_t)asize.width, ((size_t)asize.height + rowsPerWI - 1) / rowsPerWI };
3593 return k.run(2, globalsize, NULL, false);
3594}

3600namespace {
3601
3602#define VAL(buf, elem) (((T*)((char*)data ## buf + (step ## buf * (elem))))[0])
3603#define MUL_SPECTRUMS_COL(A, B, C) \
3604 VAL(C, 0) = VAL(A, 0) * VAL(B, 0); \
3605 for (size_t j = 1; j <= rows - 2; j += 2) \
3606 { \
3607 double a_re = VAL(A, j), a_im = VAL(A, j + 1); \
3608 double b_re = VAL(B, j), b_im = VAL(B, j + 1); \
3609 if (conjB) b_im = -b_im; \
3610 double c_re = a_re * b_re - a_im * b_im; \
3611 double c_im = a_re * b_im + a_im * b_re; \
3612 VAL(C, j) = (T)c_re; VAL(C, j + 1) = (T)c_im; \
3613 } \
3614 if ((rows & 1) == 0) \
3615 VAL(C, rows-1) = VAL(A, rows-1) * VAL(B, rows-1)
3616
3617template <typename T, bool conjB> static inline
3618void mulSpectrums_processCol_noinplace(const T* dataA, const T* dataB, T* dataC, size_t stepA, size_t stepB, size_t stepC, size_t rows)
3619{
3620 MUL_SPECTRUMS_COL(A, B, C);
3621}
3622
3623template <typename T, bool conjB> static inline
3624void mulSpectrums_processCol_inplaceA(const T* dataB, T* dataAC, size_t stepB, size_t stepAC, size_t rows)
3625{
3626 MUL_SPECTRUMS_COL(AC, B, AC);
3627}
3628template <typename T, bool conjB, bool inplaceA> static inline
3629void mulSpectrums_processCol(const T* dataA, const T* dataB, T* dataC, size_t stepA, size_t stepB, size_t stepC, size_t rows)
3630{
3631 if (inplaceA)
3632 mulSpectrums_processCol_inplaceA<T, conjB>(dataB, dataC, stepB, stepC, rows);
3633 else
3634 mulSpectrums_processCol_noinplace<T, conjB>(dataA, dataB, dataC, stepA, stepB, stepC, rows);
3635}
3636#undef MUL_SPECTRUMS_COL
3637#undef VAL
3638
3639template <typename T, bool conjB, bool inplaceA> static inline
3640void mulSpectrums_processCols(const T* dataA, const T* dataB, T* dataC, size_t stepA, size_t stepB, size_t stepC, size_t rows, size_t cols)
3641{
3642 mulSpectrums_processCol<T, conjB, inplaceA>(dataA, dataB, dataC, stepA, stepB, stepC, rows);
3643 if ((cols & 1) == 0)
3644 {
3645 mulSpectrums_processCol<T, conjB, inplaceA>(dataA + cols - 1, dataB + cols - 1, dataC + cols - 1, stepA, stepB, stepC, rows);
3646 }
3647}
3648
3649#define VAL(buf, elem) (data ## buf[(elem)])
3650#define MUL_SPECTRUMS_ROW(A, B, C) \
3651 for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; j += 2) \
3652 { \
3653 double a_re = VAL(A, j), a_im = VAL(A, j + 1); \
3654 double b_re = VAL(B, j), b_im = VAL(B, j + 1); \
3655 if (conjB) b_im = -b_im; \
3656 double c_re = a_re * b_re - a_im * b_im; \
3657 double c_im = a_re * b_im + a_im * b_re; \
3658 VAL(C, j) = (T)c_re; VAL(C, j + 1) = (T)c_im; \
3659 }
3660template <typename T, bool conjB> static inline
3661void mulSpectrums_processRow_noinplace(const T* dataA, const T* dataB, T* dataC, size_t j0, size_t j1)
3662{
3663 MUL_SPECTRUMS_ROW(A, B, C);
3664}
3665template <typename T, bool conjB> static inline
3666void mulSpectrums_processRow_inplaceA(const T* dataB, T* dataAC, size_t j0, size_t j1)
3667{
3668 MUL_SPECTRUMS_ROW(AC, B, AC);
3669}
3670template <typename T, bool conjB, bool inplaceA> static inline
3671void mulSpectrums_processRow(const T* dataA, const T* dataB, T* dataC, size_t j0, size_t j1)
3672{
3673 if (inplaceA)
3674 mulSpectrums_processRow_inplaceA<T, conjB>(dataB, dataC, j0, j1);
3675 else
3676 mulSpectrums_processRow_noinplace<T, conjB>(dataA, dataB, dataC, j0, j1);
3677}
3678#undef MUL_SPECTRUMS_ROW
3679#undef VAL
3680
3681template <typename T, bool conjB, bool inplaceA> static inline
3682void mulSpectrums_processRows(const T* dataA, const T* dataB, T* dataC, size_t stepA, size_t stepB, size_t stepC, size_t rows, size_t cols, size_t j0, size_t j1, bool is_1d_CN1)
3683{
3684 while (rows-- > 0)
3685 {
3686 if (is_1d_CN1)
3687 dataC[0] = dataA[0]*dataB[0];
3688 mulSpectrums_processRow<T, conjB, inplaceA>(dataA, dataB, dataC, j0, j1);
3689 if (is_1d_CN1 && (cols & 1) == 0)
3690 dataC[j1] = dataA[j1]*dataB[j1];
3691
3692 dataA = (const T*)(((char*)dataA) + stepA);
3693 dataB = (const T*)(((char*)dataB) + stepB);
3694 dataC = (T*)(((char*)dataC) + stepC);
3695 }
3696}
3697
3698
3699template <typename T, bool conjB, bool inplaceA> static inline
3700void mulSpectrums_Impl_(const T* dataA, const T* dataB, T* dataC, size_t stepA, size_t stepB, size_t stepC, size_t rows, size_t cols, size_t j0, size_t j1, bool is_1d, bool isCN1)
3701{
3702 if (!is_1d && isCN1)
3703 {
3704 mulSpectrums_processCols<T, conjB, inplaceA>(dataA, dataB, dataC, stepA, stepB, stepC, rows, cols);
3705 }
3706 mulSpectrums_processRows<T, conjB, inplaceA>(dataA, dataB, dataC, stepA, stepB, stepC, rows, cols, j0, j1, is_1d && isCN1);
3707}
3708template <typename T, bool conjB> static inline
3709void mulSpectrums_Impl(const T* dataA, const T* dataB, T* dataC, size_t stepA, size_t stepB, size_t stepC, size_t rows, size_t cols, size_t j0, size_t j1, bool is_1d, bool isCN1)
3710{
3711 if (dataA == dataC)
3712 mulSpectrums_Impl_<T, conjB, true>(dataA, dataB, dataC, stepA, stepB, stepC, rows, cols, j0, j1, is_1d, isCN1);
3713 else
3714 mulSpectrums_Impl_<T, conjB, false>(dataA, dataB, dataC, stepA, stepB, stepC, rows, cols, j0, j1, is_1d, isCN1);
3715}
3716
3717} // namespace
3718
3719void cv::mulSpectrums( InputArray _srcA, InputArray _srcB,
3720 OutputArray _dst, int flags, bool conjB )
3721{
3722 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
3723
3724 CV_OCL_RUN(_dst.isUMat() && _srcA.dims() <= 2 && _srcB.dims() <= 2,
3725 ocl_mulSpectrums(_srcA, _srcB, _dst, flags, conjB))
3726
3727 Mat srcA = _srcA.getMat(), srcB = _srcB.getMat();
3728 int depth = srcA.depth(), cn = srcA.channels(), type = srcA.type();
3729 size_t rows = srcA.rows, cols = srcA.cols;
3730
3731 CV_Assert( type == srcB.type() && srcA.size() == srcB.size() );
3732 CV_Assert( type == CV_32FC1 || type == CV_32FC2 || type == CV_64FC1 || type == CV_64FC2 );
3733
3734 _dst.create( srcA.rows, srcA.cols, type );
3735 Mat dst = _dst.getMat();
3736
3737 // correct inplace support
3738 // Case 'dst.data == srcA.data' is handled by implementation,
3739 // because it is used frequently (filter2D, matchTemplate)
3740 if (dst.data == srcB.data)
3741 srcB = srcB.clone(); // workaround for B only
3742
3743 bool is_1d = (flags & DFT_ROWS)
3744 || (rows == 1)
3745 || (cols == 1 && srcA.isContinuous() && srcB.isContinuous() && dst.isContinuous());
3746
3747 if( is_1d && !(flags & DFT_ROWS) )
3748 cols = cols + rows - 1, rows = 1;
3749
3750 bool isCN1 = cn == 1;
3751 size_t j0 = isCN1 ? 1 : 0;
3752 size_t j1 = cols*cn - (((cols & 1) == 0 && cn == 1) ? 1 : 0);
3753
3754 if (depth == CV_32F)
3755 {
3756 const float* dataA = srcA.ptr<float>();
3757 const float* dataB = srcB.ptr<float>();
3758 float* dataC = dst.ptr<float>();
3759 if (!conjB)
3760 mulSpectrums_Impl<float, false>(dataA, dataB, dataC, srcA.step, srcB.step, dst.step, rows, cols, j0, j1, is_1d, isCN1);
3761 else
3762 mulSpectrums_Impl<float, true>(dataA, dataB, dataC, srcA.step, srcB.step, dst.step, rows, cols, j0, j1, is_1d, isCN1);
3763 }
3764 else
3765 {
3766 const double* dataA = srcA.ptr<double>();
3767 const double* dataB = srcB.ptr<double>();
3768 double* dataC = dst.ptr<double>();
3769 if (!conjB)
3770 mulSpectrums_Impl<double, false>(dataA, dataB, dataC, srcA.step, srcB.step, dst.step, rows, cols, j0, j1, is_1d, isCN1);
3771 else
3772 mulSpectrums_Impl<double, true>(dataA, dataB, dataC, srcA.step, srcB.step, dst.step, rows, cols, j0, j1, is_1d, isCN1);
3773 }
3774}
3775
3776void cv::divSpectrums( InputArray _srcA, InputArray _srcB, OutputArray _dst, int flags, bool conjB)
3777{
3778 Mat srcA = _srcA.getMat(), srcB = _srcB.getMat();
3779 int depth = srcA.depth(), cn = srcA.channels(), type = srcA.type();
3780 int rows = srcA.rows, cols = srcA.cols;
3781 int j, k;
3782
3783 CV_Assert( type == srcB.type() && srcA.size() == srcB.size() );
3784 CV_Assert( type == CV_32FC1 || type == CV_32FC2 || type == CV_64FC1 || type == CV_64FC2 );
3785
3786 _dst.create( srcA.rows, srcA.cols, type );
3787 Mat dst = _dst.getMat();
3788
3789 CV_Assert(dst.data != srcA.data); // non-inplace check
3790 CV_Assert(dst.data != srcB.data); // non-inplace check
3791
3792 bool is_1d = (flags & DFT_ROWS) || (rows == 1 || (cols == 1 &&
3793 srcA.isContinuous() && srcB.isContinuous() && dst.isContinuous()));
3794
3795 if( is_1d && !(flags & DFT_ROWS) )
3796 cols = cols + rows - 1, rows = 1;
3797
3798 int ncols = cols*cn;
3799 int j0 = cn == 1;
3800 int j1 = ncols - (cols % 2 == 0 && cn == 1);
3801
3802 if( depth == CV_32F )
3803 {
3804 const float* dataA = srcA.ptr<float>();
3805 const float* dataB = srcB.ptr<float>();
3806 float* dataC = dst.ptr<float>();
3807 float eps = FLT_EPSILON; // prevent div0 problems
3808
3809 size_t stepA = srcA.step/sizeof(dataA[0]);
3810 size_t stepB = srcB.step/sizeof(dataB[0]);
3811 size_t stepC = dst.step/sizeof(dataC[0]);
3812
3813 if( !is_1d && cn == 1 )
3814 {
3815 for( k = 0; k < (cols % 2 ? 1 : 2); k++ )
3816 {
3817 if( k == 1 )
3818 dataA += cols - 1, dataB += cols - 1, dataC += cols - 1;
3819 dataC[0] = dataA[0] / (dataB[0] + eps);
3820 if( rows % 2 == 0 )
3821 dataC[(rows-1)*stepC] = dataA[(rows-1)*stepA] / (dataB[(rows-1)*stepB] + eps);
3822 if( !conjB )
3823 for( j = 1; j <= rows - 2; j += 2 )
3824 {
3825 double denom = (double)dataB[j*stepB]*dataB[j*stepB] +
3826 (double)dataB[(j+1)*stepB]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB] + (double)eps;
3827
3828 double re = (double)dataA[j*stepA]*dataB[j*stepB] +
3829 (double)dataA[(j+1)*stepA]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB];
3830
3831 double im = (double)dataA[(j+1)*stepA]*dataB[j*stepB] -
3832 (double)dataA[j*stepA]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB];
3833
3834 dataC[j*stepC] = (float)(re / denom);
3835 dataC[(j+1)*stepC] = (float)(im / denom);
3836 }
3837 else
3838 for( j = 1; j <= rows - 2; j += 2 )
3839 {
3840
3841 double denom = (double)dataB[j*stepB]*dataB[j*stepB] +
3842 (double)dataB[(j+1)*stepB]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB] + (double)eps;
3843
3844 double re = (double)dataA[j*stepA]*dataB[j*stepB] -
3845 (double)dataA[(j+1)*stepA]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB];
3846
3847 double im = (double)dataA[(j+1)*stepA]*dataB[j*stepB] +
3848 (double)dataA[j*stepA]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB];
3849
3850 dataC[j*stepC] = (float)(re / denom);
3851 dataC[(j+1)*stepC] = (float)(im / denom);
3852 }
3853 if( k == 1 )
3854 dataA -= cols - 1, dataB -= cols - 1, dataC -= cols - 1;
3855 }
3856 }
3857
3858 for( ; rows--; dataA += stepA, dataB += stepB, dataC += stepC )
3859 {
3860 if( is_1d && cn == 1 )
3861 {
3862 dataC[0] = dataA[0] / (dataB[0] + eps);
3863 if( cols % 2 == 0 )
3864 dataC[j1] = dataA[j1] / (dataB[j1] + eps);
3865 }
3866
3867 if( !conjB )
3868 for( j = j0; j < j1; j += 2 )
3869 {
3870 double denom = (double)dataB[j]*dataB[j] + (double)dataB[j+1]*dataB[j+1] + (double)eps;
3871 double re = (double)dataA[j]*dataB[j] + (double)dataA[j+1]*dataB[j+1];
3872 double im = (double)dataA[j+1]*dataB[j] - (double)dataA[j]*dataB[j+1];
3873 dataC[j] = (float)(re / denom);
3874 dataC[j+1] = (float)(im / denom);
3875 }
3876 else
3877 for( j = j0; j < j1; j += 2 )
3878 {
3879 double denom = (double)dataB[j]*dataB[j] + (double)dataB[j+1]*dataB[j+1] + (double)eps;
3880 double re = (double)dataA[j]*dataB[j] - (double)dataA[j+1]*dataB[j+1];
3881 double im = (double)dataA[j+1]*dataB[j] + (double)dataA[j]*dataB[j+1];
3882 dataC[j] = (float)(re / denom);
3883 dataC[j+1] = (float)(im / denom);
3884 }
3885 }
3886 }
3887 else
3888 {
3889 const double* dataA = srcA.ptr<double>();
3890 const double* dataB = srcB.ptr<double>();
3891 double* dataC = dst.ptr<double>();
3892 double eps = DBL_EPSILON; // prevent div0 problems
3893
3894 size_t stepA = srcA.step/sizeof(dataA[0]);
3895 size_t stepB = srcB.step/sizeof(dataB[0]);
3896 size_t stepC = dst.step/sizeof(dataC[0]);
3897
3898 if( !is_1d && cn == 1 )
3899 {
3900 for( k = 0; k < (cols % 2 ? 1 : 2); k++ )
3901 {
3902 if( k == 1 )
3903 dataA += cols - 1, dataB += cols - 1, dataC += cols - 1;
3904 dataC[0] = dataA[0] / (dataB[0] + eps);
3905 if( rows % 2 == 0 )
3906 dataC[(rows-1)*stepC] = dataA[(rows-1)*stepA] / (dataB[(rows-1)*stepB] + eps);
3907 if( !conjB )
3908 for( j = 1; j <= rows - 2; j += 2 )
3909 {
3910 double denom = dataB[j*stepB]*dataB[j*stepB] +
3911 dataB[(j+1)*stepB]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB] + eps;
3912
3913 double re = dataA[j*stepA]*dataB[j*stepB] +
3914 dataA[(j+1)*stepA]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB];
3915
3916 double im = dataA[(j+1)*stepA]*dataB[j*stepB] -
3917 dataA[j*stepA]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB];
3918
3919 dataC[j*stepC] = re / denom;
3920 dataC[(j+1)*stepC] = im / denom;
3921 }
3922 else
3923 for( j = 1; j <= rows - 2; j += 2 )
3924 {
3925 double denom = dataB[j*stepB]*dataB[j*stepB] +
3926 dataB[(j+1)*stepB]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB] + eps;
3927
3928 double re = dataA[j*stepA]*dataB[j*stepB] -
3929 dataA[(j+1)*stepA]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB];
3930
3931 double im = dataA[(j+1)*stepA]*dataB[j*stepB] +
3932 dataA[j*stepA]*dataB[(j+1)*stepB];
3933
3934 dataC[j*stepC] = re / denom;
3935 dataC[(j+1)*stepC] = im / denom;
3936 }
3937 if( k == 1 )
3938 dataA -= cols - 1, dataB -= cols - 1, dataC -= cols - 1;
3939 }
3940 }
3941
3942 for( ; rows--; dataA += stepA, dataB += stepB, dataC += stepC )
3943 {
3944 if( is_1d && cn == 1 )
3945 {
3946 dataC[0] = dataA[0] / (dataB[0] + eps);
3947 if( cols % 2 == 0 )
3948 dataC[j1] = dataA[j1] / (dataB[j1] + eps);
3949 }
3950
3951 if( !conjB )
3952 for( j = j0; j < j1; j += 2 )
3953 {
3954 double denom = dataB[j]*dataB[j] + dataB[j+1]*dataB[j+1] + eps;
3955 double re = dataA[j]*dataB[j] + dataA[j+1]*dataB[j+1];
3956 double im = dataA[j+1]*dataB[j] - dataA[j]*dataB[j+1];
3957 dataC[j] = re / denom;
3958 dataC[j+1] = im / denom;
3959 }
3960 else
3961 for( j = j0; j < j1; j += 2 )
3962 {
3963 double denom = dataB[j]*dataB[j] + dataB[j+1]*dataB[j+1] + eps;
3964 double re = dataA[j]*dataB[j] - dataA[j+1]*dataB[j+1];
3965 double im = dataA[j+1]*dataB[j] + dataA[j]*dataB[j+1];
3966 dataC[j] = re / denom;
3967 dataC[j+1] = im / denom;
3968 }
3969 }
3970 }
3971}

3973/****************************************************************************************\
3974 Discrete Cosine Transform
3975\****************************************************************************************/
3976
3977namespace cv
3978{
3979
3980/* DCT is calculated using DFT, as described here:
3981 http://www.ece.utexas.edu/~bevans/courses/ee381k/lectures/09_DCT/lecture9/:
3982*/
3983template<typename T> static void
3984DCT( const OcvDftOptions & c, const T* src, size_t src_step, T* dft_src, T* dft_dst, T* dst, size_t dst_step,
3985 const Complex<T>* dct_wave )
3986{
3987 static const T sin_45 = (T)0.70710678118654752440084436210485;
3988
3989 int n = c.n;
3990 int j, n2 = n >> 1;
3991
3992 src_step /= sizeof(src[0]);
3993 dst_step /= sizeof(dst[0]);
3994 T* dst1 = dst + (n-1)*dst_step;
3995
3996 if( n == 1 )
3997 {
3998 dst[0] = src[0];
3999 return;
4000 }
4001
4002 for( j = 0; j < n2; j++, src += src_step*2 )
4003 {
4004 dft_src[j] = src[0];
4005 dft_src[n-j-1] = src[src_step];
4006 }
4007
4008 RealDFT(c, dft_src, dft_dst);
4009 src = dft_dst;
4010
4011 dst[0] = (T)(src[0]*dct_wave->re*sin_45);
4012 dst += dst_step;
4013 for( j = 1, dct_wave++; j < n2; j++, dct_wave++,
4014 dst += dst_step, dst1 -= dst_step )
4015 {
4016 T t0 = dct_wave->re*src[j*2-1] - dct_wave->im*src[j*2];
4017 T t1 = -dct_wave->im*src[j*2-1] - dct_wave->re*src[j*2];
4018 dst[0] = t0;
4019 dst1[0] = t1;
4020 }
4021
4022 dst[0] = src[n-1]*dct_wave->re;
4023}
4024
4025
4026template<typename T> static void
4027IDCT( const OcvDftOptions & c, const T* src, size_t src_step, T* dft_src, T* dft_dst, T* dst, size_t dst_step,
4028 const Complex<T>* dct_wave)
4029{
4030 static const T sin_45 = (T)0.70710678118654752440084436210485;
4031 int n = c.n;
4032 int j, n2 = n >> 1;
4033
4034 src_step /= sizeof(src[0]);
4035 dst_step /= sizeof(dst[0]);
4036 const T* src1 = src + (n-1)*src_step;
4037
4038 if( n == 1 )
4039 {
4040 dst[0] = src[0];
4041 return;
4042 }
4043
4044 dft_src[0] = (T)(src[0]*2*dct_wave->re*sin_45);
4045 src += src_step;
4046 for( j = 1, dct_wave++; j < n2; j++, dct_wave++,
4047 src += src_step, src1 -= src_step )
4048 {
4049 T t0 = dct_wave->re*src[0] - dct_wave->im*src1[0];
4050 T t1 = -dct_wave->im*src[0] - dct_wave->re*src1[0];
4051 dft_src[j*2-1] = t0;
4052 dft_src[j*2] = t1;
4053 }
4054
4055 dft_src[n-1] = (T)(src[0]*2*dct_wave->re);
4056 CCSIDFT(c, dft_src, dft_dst);
4057
4058 for( j = 0; j < n2; j++, dst += dst_step*2 )
4059 {
4060 dst[0] = dft_dst[j];
4061 dst[dst_step] = dft_dst[n-j-1];
4062 }
4063}
4064
4065
4066static void
4067DCTInit( int n, int elem_size, void* _wave, int inv )
4068{
4069 static const double DctScale[] =
4070 {
4071 0.707106781186547570, 0.500000000000000000, 0.353553390593273790,
4072 0.250000000000000000, 0.176776695296636890, 0.125000000000000000,
4073 0.088388347648318447, 0.062500000000000000, 0.044194173824159223,
4074 0.031250000000000000, 0.022097086912079612, 0.015625000000000000,
4075 0.011048543456039806, 0.007812500000000000, 0.005524271728019903,
4076 0.003906250000000000, 0.002762135864009952, 0.001953125000000000,
4077 0.001381067932004976, 0.000976562500000000, 0.000690533966002488,
4078 0.000488281250000000, 0.000345266983001244, 0.000244140625000000,
4079 0.000172633491500622, 0.000122070312500000, 0.000086316745750311,
4080 0.000061035156250000, 0.000043158372875155, 0.000030517578125000
4081 };
4082
4083 int i;
4084 Complex<double> w, w1;
4085 double t, scale;
4086
4087 if( n == 1 )
4088 return;
4089
4090 CV_Assert( (n&1) == 0 );
4091
4092 if( (n & (n - 1)) == 0 )
4093 {
4094 int m;
4095 for( m = 0; (unsigned)(1 << m) < (unsigned)n; m++ )
4096 ;
4097 scale = (!inv ? 2 : 1)*DctScale[m];
4098 w1.re = DFTTab[m+2][0];
4099 w1.im = -DFTTab[m+2][1];
4100 }
4101 else
4102 {
4103 t = 1./(2*n);
4104 scale = (!inv ? 2 : 1)*std::sqrt(t);
4105 w1.im = sin(-CV_PI*t);
4106 w1.re = std::sqrt(1. - w1.im*w1.im);
4107 }
4108 n >>= 1;
4109
4110 if( elem_size == sizeof(Complex<double>) )
4111 {
4112 Complex<double>* wave = (Complex<double>*)_wave;
4113
4114 w.re = scale;
4115 w.im = 0.;
4116
4117 for( i = 0; i <= n; i++ )
4118 {
4119 wave[i] = w;
4120 t = w.re*w1.re - w.im*w1.im;
4121 w.im = w.re*w1.im + w.im*w1.re;
4122 w.re = t;
4123 }
4124 }
4125 else
4126 {
4127 Complex<float>* wave = (Complex<float>*)_wave;
4128 CV_Assert( elem_size == sizeof(Complex<float>) );
4129
4130 w.re = (float)scale;
4131 w.im = 0.f;
4132
4133 for( i = 0; i <= n; i++ )
4134 {
4135 wave[i].re = (float)w.re;
4136 wave[i].im = (float)w.im;
4137 t = w.re*w1.re - w.im*w1.im;
4138 w.im = w.re*w1.im + w.im*w1.re;
4139 w.re = t;
4140 }
4141 }
4142}
4143
4144
4145typedef void (*DCTFunc)(const OcvDftOptions & c, const void* src, size_t src_step, void* dft_src,
4146 void* dft_dst, void* dst, size_t dst_step, const void* dct_wave);

4189class DctIPPLoop_Invoker : public ParallelLoopBody
4190{
4191public:
4192 DctIPPLoop_Invoker(const uchar * _src, size_t _src_step, uchar * _dst, size_t _dst_step, int _width, bool _inv, bool *_ok) :
4193 ParallelLoopBody(), src(_src), src_step(_src_step), dst(_dst), dst_step(_dst_step), width(_width), inv(_inv), ok(_ok)
4194 {
4195 *ok = true;
4196 }
4197
4198 virtual void operator()(const Range& range) const CV_OVERRIDE
4199 {
4200 if(*ok == false)
4201 return;
4202
4203#if IPP_VERSION_X100 >= 900
4204 IppiSize srcRoiSize = {width, 1};
4205
4206 int specSize = 0;
4207 int initSize = 0;
4208 int bufferSize = 0;
4209
4210 Ipp8u* pDCTSpec = NULL;
4211 Ipp8u* pBuffer = NULL;
4212 Ipp8u* pInitBuf = NULL;
4213
4214 #define IPP_RETURN \
4215 if(pDCTSpec) \
4216 ippFree(pDCTSpec); \
4217 if(pBuffer) \
4218 ippFree(pBuffer); \
4219 if(pInitBuf) \
4220 ippFree(pInitBuf); \
4221 return;
4222
4223 ippiDCTFunc ippiDCT_32f_C1R = inv ? (ippiDCTFunc)ippiDCTInv_32f_C1R : (ippiDCTFunc)ippiDCTFwd_32f_C1R;
4224 ippiDCTInit ippDctInit = inv ? (ippiDCTInit)ippiDCTInvInit_32f : (ippiDCTInit)ippiDCTFwdInit_32f;
4225 ippiDCTGetSize ippDctGetSize = inv ? (ippiDCTGetSize)ippiDCTInvGetSize_32f : (ippiDCTGetSize)ippiDCTFwdGetSize_32f;
4226
4227 if(ippDctGetSize(srcRoiSize, &specSize, &initSize, &bufferSize) < 0)
4228 {
4229 *ok = false;
4230 return;
4231 }
4232
4233 pDCTSpec = (Ipp8u*)CV_IPP_MALLOC(specSize);
4234 if(!pDCTSpec && specSize)
4235 {
4236 *ok = false;
4237 return;
4238 }
4239
4240 pBuffer = (Ipp8u*)CV_IPP_MALLOC(bufferSize);
4241 if(!pBuffer && bufferSize)
4242 {
4243 *ok = false;
4244 IPP_RETURN
4245 }
4246 pInitBuf = (Ipp8u*)CV_IPP_MALLOC(initSize);
4247 if(!pInitBuf && initSize)
4248 {
4249 *ok = false;
4250 IPP_RETURN
4251 }
4252
4253 if(ippDctInit(pDCTSpec, srcRoiSize, pInitBuf) < 0)
4254 {
4255 *ok = false;
4256 IPP_RETURN
4257 }
4258
4259 for(int i = range.start; i < range.end; ++i)
4260 {
4261 if(CV_INSTRUMENT_FUN_IPP(ippiDCT_32f_C1R, (float*)(src + src_step * i), static_cast<int>(src_step), (float*)(dst + dst_step * i), static_cast<int>(dst_step), pDCTSpec, pBuffer) < 0)
4262 {
4263 *ok = false;
4264 IPP_RETURN
4265 }
4266 }
4267 IPP_RETURN
4268#undef IPP_RETURN
4269#elif IPP_VERSION_X100 >= 700
4270 void* pDCTSpec;
4271 AutoBuffer<uchar> buf;
4272 uchar* pBuffer = 0;
4273 int bufSize=0;
4274
4275 IppiSize srcRoiSize = {width, 1};
4276
4277 CV_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATED_START
4278
4279 ippiDCTFunc ippDctFun = inv ? (ippiDCTFunc)ippiDCTInv_32f_C1R : (ippiDCTFunc)ippiDCTFwd_32f_C1R;
4280 ippiDCTInitAlloc ippInitAlloc = inv ? (ippiDCTInitAlloc)ippiDCTInvInitAlloc_32f : (ippiDCTInitAlloc)ippiDCTFwdInitAlloc_32f;
4281 ippiDCTFree ippFree = inv ? (ippiDCTFree)ippiDCTInvFree_32f : (ippiDCTFree)ippiDCTFwdFree_32f;
4282 ippiDCTGetBufSize ippGetBufSize = inv ? (ippiDCTGetBufSize)ippiDCTInvGetBufSize_32f : (ippiDCTGetBufSize)ippiDCTFwdGetBufSize_32f;
4283
4284 if (ippInitAlloc(&pDCTSpec, srcRoiSize, ippAlgHintNone)>=0 && ippGetBufSize(pDCTSpec, &bufSize)>=0)
4285 {
4286 buf.allocate( bufSize );
4287 pBuffer = (uchar*)buf;
4288
4289 for( int i = range.start; i < range.end; ++i)
4290 {
4291 if(ippDctFun((float*)(src + src_step * i), static_cast<int>(src_step), (float*)(dst + dst_step * i), static_cast<int>(dst_step), pDCTSpec, (Ipp8u*)pBuffer) < 0)
4292 {
4293 *ok = false;
4294 break;
4295 }
4296 }
4297 }
4298 else
4299 *ok = false;
4300
4301 if (pDCTSpec)
4302 ippFree(pDCTSpec);
4303
4304 CV_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATED_END
4305#else
4306 CV_UNUSED(range);
4307 *ok = false;
4308#endif
4309 }

4311private:

4313 size_t src_step;
4314 uchar * dst;
4315 size_t dst_step;
4316 int width;
4317 bool inv;
4318 bool *ok;

4321static bool DctIPPLoop(const uchar * src, size_t src_step, uchar * dst, size_t dst_step, int width, int height, bool inv)
4322{
4323 bool ok;
4324 parallel_for_(Range(0, height), DctIPPLoop_Invoker(src, src_step, dst, dst_step, width, inv, &ok), height/(double)(1<<4) );
4325 return ok;
4326}

4328static bool ippi_DCT_32f(const uchar * src, size_t src_step, uchar * dst, size_t dst_step, int width, int height, bool inv, bool row)
4329{
4330 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION_IPP();
4331
4332 if(row)
4333 return DctIPPLoop(src, src_step, dst, dst_step, width, height, inv);
4334 else
4335 {
4336#if IPP_VERSION_X100 >= 900
4337 IppiSize srcRoiSize = {width, height};
4338
4339 int specSize = 0;
4340 int initSize = 0;
4341 int bufferSize = 0;
4342
4343 Ipp8u* pDCTSpec = NULL;
4344 Ipp8u* pBuffer = NULL;
4345 Ipp8u* pInitBuf = NULL;
4346
4347 #define IPP_RELEASE \
4348 if(pDCTSpec) \
4349 ippFree(pDCTSpec); \
4350 if(pBuffer) \
4351 ippFree(pBuffer); \
4352 if(pInitBuf) \
4353 ippFree(pInitBuf); \
4354
4355 ippiDCTFunc ippiDCT_32f_C1R = inv ? (ippiDCTFunc)ippiDCTInv_32f_C1R : (ippiDCTFunc)ippiDCTFwd_32f_C1R;
4356 ippiDCTInit ippDctInit = inv ? (ippiDCTInit)ippiDCTInvInit_32f : (ippiDCTInit)ippiDCTFwdInit_32f;
4357 ippiDCTGetSize ippDctGetSize = inv ? (ippiDCTGetSize)ippiDCTInvGetSize_32f : (ippiDCTGetSize)ippiDCTFwdGetSize_32f;
4358
4359 if(ippDctGetSize(srcRoiSize, &specSize, &initSize, &bufferSize) < 0)
4360 return false;
4361
4362 pDCTSpec = (Ipp8u*)CV_IPP_MALLOC(specSize);
4363 if(!pDCTSpec && specSize)
4364 return false;
4365
4366 pBuffer = (Ipp8u*)CV_IPP_MALLOC(bufferSize);
4367 if(!pBuffer && bufferSize)
4368 {
4369 IPP_RELEASE
4370 return false;
4371 }
4372 pInitBuf = (Ipp8u*)CV_IPP_MALLOC(initSize);
4373 if(!pInitBuf && initSize)
4374 {
4375 IPP_RELEASE
4376 return false;
4377 }
4378
4379 if(ippDctInit(pDCTSpec, srcRoiSize, pInitBuf) < 0)
4380 {
4381 IPP_RELEASE
4382 return false;
4383 }
4384
4385 if(CV_INSTRUMENT_FUN_IPP(ippiDCT_32f_C1R, (float*)src, static_cast<int>(src_step), (float*)dst, static_cast<int>(dst_step), pDCTSpec, pBuffer) < 0)
4386 {
4387 IPP_RELEASE
4388 return false;
4389 }
4390
4391 IPP_RELEASE
4392 return true;
4393#undef IPP_RELEASE
4394#elif IPP_VERSION_X100 >= 700
4395 IppStatus status;
4396 void* pDCTSpec;
4397 AutoBuffer<uchar> buf;
4398 uchar* pBuffer = 0;
4399 int bufSize=0;
4400
4401 IppiSize srcRoiSize = {width, height};
4402
4403 CV_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATED_START
4404
4405 ippiDCTFunc ippDctFun = inv ? (ippiDCTFunc)ippiDCTInv_32f_C1R : (ippiDCTFunc)ippiDCTFwd_32f_C1R;
4406 ippiDCTInitAlloc ippInitAlloc = inv ? (ippiDCTInitAlloc)ippiDCTInvInitAlloc_32f : (ippiDCTInitAlloc)ippiDCTFwdInitAlloc_32f;
4407 ippiDCTFree ippFree = inv ? (ippiDCTFree)ippiDCTInvFree_32f : (ippiDCTFree)ippiDCTFwdFree_32f;
4408 ippiDCTGetBufSize ippGetBufSize = inv ? (ippiDCTGetBufSize)ippiDCTInvGetBufSize_32f : (ippiDCTGetBufSize)ippiDCTFwdGetBufSize_32f;
4409
4410 status = ippStsErr;
4411
4412 if (ippInitAlloc(&pDCTSpec, srcRoiSize, ippAlgHintNone)>=0 && ippGetBufSize(pDCTSpec, &bufSize)>=0)
4413 {
4414 buf.allocate( bufSize );
4415 pBuffer = (uchar*)buf;
4416
4417 status = ippDctFun((float*)src, static_cast<int>(src_step), (float*)dst, static_cast<int>(dst_step), pDCTSpec, (Ipp8u*)pBuffer);
4418 }
4419
4420 if (pDCTSpec)
4421 ippFree(pDCTSpec);
4422
4423 CV_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATED_END
4424
4425 return status >= 0;
4426#else
4427 CV_UNUSED(src); CV_UNUSED(dst); CV_UNUSED(inv); CV_UNUSED(row);
4428 return false;
4429#endif
4430 }
4431}

4436
4437class OcvDctImpl CV_FINAL : public hal::DCT2D
4438{
4439public:
4440 OcvDftOptions opt;
4441
4442 int _factors[34];
4443 AutoBuffer<uint> wave_buf;
4444 AutoBuffer<int> itab_buf;
4445
4446 DCTFunc dct_func;
4447 bool isRowTransform;
4448 bool isInverse;
4449 bool isContinuous;
4450 int start_stage;
4451 int end_stage;
4452 int width;
4453 int height;
4454 int depth;
4455
4456 void init(int _width, int _height, int _depth, int flags)
4457 {
4458 width = _width;
4459 height = _height;
4460 depth = _depth;
4461 isInverse = (flags & CV_HAL_DFT_INVERSE) != 0;
4462 isRowTransform = (flags & CV_HAL_DFT_ROWS) != 0;
4463 isContinuous = (flags & CV_HAL_DFT_IS_CONTINUOUS) != 0;
4464 static DCTFunc dct_tbl[4] =
4465 {
4466 (DCTFunc)DCT_32f,
4467 (DCTFunc)IDCT_32f,
4468 (DCTFunc)DCT_64f,
4469 (DCTFunc)IDCT_64f
4470 };
4471 dct_func = dct_tbl[(int)isInverse + (depth == CV_64F)*2];
4472 opt.nf = 0;
4473 opt.isComplex = false;
4474 opt.isInverse = false;
4475 opt.noPermute = false;
4476 opt.scale = 1.;
4477 opt.factors = _factors;
4478
4479 if (isRowTransform || height == 1 || (width == 1 && isContinuous))
4480 {
4481 start_stage = end_stage = 0;
4482 }
4483 else
4484 {
4485 start_stage = (width == 1);
4486 end_stage = 1;
4487 }
4488 }
4489 void apply(const uchar *src, size_t src_step, uchar *dst, size_t dst_step) CV_OVERRIDE
4490 {
4491 CV_IPP_RUN(IPP_VERSION_X100 >= 700 && depth == CV_32F, ippi_DCT_32f(src, src_step, dst, dst_step, width, height, isInverse, isRowTransform))
4492
4493 AutoBuffer<uchar> dct_wave;
4494 AutoBuffer<uchar> src_buf, dst_buf;
4495 uchar *src_dft_buf = 0, *dst_dft_buf = 0;
4496 int prev_len = 0;
4497 int elem_size = (depth == CV_32F) ? sizeof(float) : sizeof(double);
4498 int complex_elem_size = elem_size*2;
4499
4500 for(int stage = start_stage ; stage <= end_stage; stage++ )
4501 {
4502 const uchar* sptr = src;
4503 uchar* dptr = dst;
4504 size_t sstep0, sstep1, dstep0, dstep1;
4505 int len, count;
4506
4507 if( stage == 0 )
4508 {
4509 len = width;
4510 count = height;
4511 if( len == 1 && !isRowTransform )
4512 {
4513 len = height;
4514 count = 1;
4515 }
4516 sstep0 = src_step;
4517 dstep0 = dst_step;
4518 sstep1 = dstep1 = elem_size;
4519 }
4520 else
4521 {
4522 len = height;
4523 count = width;
4524 sstep1 = src_step;
4525 dstep1 = dst_step;
4526 sstep0 = dstep0 = elem_size;
4527 }
4528
4529 opt.n = len;
4530 opt.tab_size = len;
4531
4532 if( len != prev_len )
4533 {
4534 if( len > 1 && (len & 1) )
4535 CV_Error( cv::Error::StsNotImplemented, "Odd-size DCT\'s are not implemented" );
4536
4537 opt.nf = DFTFactorize( len, opt.factors );
4538 bool inplace_transform = opt.factors[0] == opt.factors[opt.nf-1];
4539
4540 wave_buf.allocate(len*complex_elem_size);
4541 opt.wave = wave_buf.data();
4542 itab_buf.allocate(len);
4543 opt.itab = itab_buf.data();
4544 DFTInit( len, opt.nf, opt.factors, opt.itab, complex_elem_size, opt.wave, isInverse );
4545
4546 dct_wave.allocate((len/2 + 1)*complex_elem_size);
4547 src_buf.allocate(len*elem_size);
4548 src_dft_buf = src_buf.data();
4549 if(!inplace_transform)
4550 {
4551 dst_buf.allocate(len*elem_size);
4552 dst_dft_buf = dst_buf.data();
4553 }
4554 else
4555 {
4556 dst_dft_buf = src_buf.data();
4557 }
4558 DCTInit( len, complex_elem_size, dct_wave.data(), isInverse);
4559 prev_len = len;
4560 }
4561 // otherwise reuse the tables calculated on the previous stage
4562 for(unsigned i = 0; i < static_cast<unsigned>(count); i++ )
4563 {
4564 dct_func( opt, sptr + i*sstep0, sstep1, src_dft_buf, dst_dft_buf,
4565 dptr + i*dstep0, dstep1, dct_wave.data());
4566 }
4567 src = dst;
4568 src_step = dst_step;
4569 }
4570 }
4571};
4572
4573struct ReplacementDCT2D : public hal::DCT2D
4574{
4575 cvhalDFT *context;
4576 bool isInitialized;
4577
4578 ReplacementDCT2D() : context(0), isInitialized(false) {}
4579 bool init(int width, int height, int depth, int flags)
4580 {
4581 int res = cv_hal_dctInit2D(&context, width, height, depth, flags);
4582 isInitialized = (res == CV_HAL_ERROR_OK);
4583 return isInitialized;
4584 }
4585 void apply(const uchar *src_data, size_t src_step, uchar *dst_data, size_t dst_step) CV_OVERRIDE
4586 {
4587 if (isInitialized)
4588 {
4589 CALL_HAL(dct2D, cv_hal_dct2D, context, src_data, src_step, dst_data, dst_step);
4590 }
4591 }
4592 ~ReplacementDCT2D()
4593 {
4594 if (isInitialized)
4595 {
4596 CALL_HAL(dctFree2D, cv_hal_dctFree2D, context);
4597 }
4598 }
4599};

4603Ptr<DCT2D> DCT2D::create(int width, int height, int depth, int flags)
4604{
4605 {
4606 ReplacementDCT2D *impl = new ReplacementDCT2D();
4607 if (impl->init(width, height, depth, flags))
4608 {
4609 return Ptr<DCT2D>(impl);
4610 }
4611 delete impl;
4612 }
4613 {
4614 OcvDctImpl *impl = new OcvDctImpl();
4615 impl->init(width, height, depth, flags);
4616 return Ptr<DCT2D>(impl);
4617 }
4618}

4623void cv::dct( InputArray _src0, OutputArray _dst, int flags )
4624{
4625 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
4626
4627 Mat src0 = _src0.getMat(), src = src0;
4628 int type = src.type(), depth = src.depth();
4629
4630 CV_Assert( type == CV_32FC1 || type == CV_64FC1 );
4631 _dst.create( src.rows, src.cols, type );
4632 Mat dst = _dst.getMat();
4633
4634 int f = 0;
4635 if ((flags & DFT_ROWS) != 0)
4636 f |= CV_HAL_DFT_ROWS;
4637 if ((flags & DCT_INVERSE) != 0)
4638 f |= CV_HAL_DFT_INVERSE;
4639 if (src.isContinuous() && dst.isContinuous())
4640 f |= CV_HAL_DFT_IS_CONTINUOUS;
4641
4642 Ptr<hal::DCT2D> c = hal::DCT2D::create(src.cols, src.rows, depth, f);
4643 c->apply(src.data, src.step, dst.data, dst.step);
4644}

4647void cv::idct( InputArray src, OutputArray dst, int flags )
4648{
4649 CV_INSTRUMENT_REGION();
4650
4651 dct( src, dst, flags | DCT_INVERSE );
4652}

4840int cv::getOptimalDFTSize( int size0 )
4841{
4842 int a = 0, b = sizeof(optimalDFTSizeTab)/sizeof(optimalDFTSizeTab[0]) - 1;
4843 if( (unsigned)size0 >= (unsigned)optimalDFTSizeTab[b] )
4844 return -1;
4845
4846 while( a < b )
4847 {
4848 int c = (a + b) >> 1;
4849 if( size0 <= optimalDFTSizeTab[c] )
4850 b = c;
4851 else
4852 a = c+1;
4853 }
4854
4855 return optimalDFTSizeTab[b];
4856}
